```python
# Import necessary libraries
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the quotes data
quotes_data = pd.read_csv('quotes.csv')

# Filter the data for the relevant tickers
relevant_tickers = ["SPY", "QQQ", "EFA", "EEM", "TLT", "IEF", "GLD", "DBC", "NVDA", "AVGO", "ORLY", "FAST"]
filtered_quotes = quotes_data[quotes_data['ticker'].isin(relevant_tickers)]

# Pivot the data to have dates as rows and tickers as columns
pivot_data = filtered_quotes.pivot(index='date', columns='ticker', values='close')

# Calculate daily returns
daily_returns = pivot_data.pct_change().dropna()

# Calculate the covariance matrix of the returns
cov_matrix = daily_returns.cov()

# Calculate the inverse of the covariance matrix
inv_cov_matrix = np.linalg.inv(cov_matrix)

# Calculate the vector of ones
ones_vector = np.ones(len(relevant_tickers))

# Calculate the portfolio weights
portfolio_weights = inv_cov_matrix @ ones_vector / (ones_vector.T @ inv_cov_matrix @ ones_vector)

# Create a dictionary of the weights
weights_dict = dict(zip(relevant_tickers, portfolio_weights))

# Ensure the weights sum to 1
total_weight = sum(weights_dict.values())
weights_dict = {ticker: weight / total_weight for ticker, weight in weights_dict.items()}

# Print the resulting weights
print(weights_dict)
```
